```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><th>A</th></tr><tr><td>1</td></tr></table><p>Between</p><table><tr><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>2</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
```
